_comment: Weekly coding-agent usage digest and per-agent budget alert (docs/coding-agent-usage.md). Re-read every tick, so a retune needs no restart.

digest: sent once a week at weekday (0 = Monday) and hour, hub-local time. Covers the last seven complete UTC days against the seven before. The first run after install waits for the next scheduled moment.
budget.tokens_per_week: agent -> token budget over the trailing seven UTC days (net input + cache writes + output, cache reads left out). An agent not listed is not watched; empty = no budget alerts.
Agent ids: claude, codex, copilot, pi, agy, claude_bridged. Categories are notify_send routing categories. script null = ~/.claude/hooks/notify_send.py.
